whale.reviewed_by: Codex: direct visual inspection of exact final native/world/icon/comparison sheets; not user sign-off
whale.notes: Own authored mesh, UV, textures and clips; no baseline geometry/pixels copied. Original required clips retained. Baseline has eight palette nodes but only one weighted joint; candidate has fourteen/ fifteen weighted joints. Native full view/motion sheets, real 64px icon, equal-scale anatomy comparison and actual final world capture directly inspected. Whale width is +15.1% to expose long pectoral blades instead of burying them in the restored broad trunk; length preserved, height -9.5%. Dragon vertical silhouette dimensions within about 3% of original, horns lengthened and head lowered after first comparison. Curved/tapered neck rings remain coincident under actual exported skinning. Earlier whale preview-only capture had no spawned world creature and was rejected; raw failed evidence retained in runtime_whale_spawn_failed. Final actual species presence verified. Gameplay bounds/speeds/habitat preserved. No added die clip: original capabilities did not include one. No performance PASS or full routes/compatibility acceptance; R6 remains pending.
